Competitor.title: Competitor
Competitor.description: Public leaderboard and daily challenge participant entry shared across all users' devices without PII.

id.description: Document ID matching the competitor identifier.

name.description: Child or competitor display name shown on the Honor Roll and Friends Challenge.

stars.description: Total stars earned by this competitor.

lastDailyChallengeDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date string of the last completed daily challenge, or empty string if not completed today.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns and updates this competitor entry.

kind.description: Whether this entry is the signed-in user's primary profile or an added companion/sibling/student.

isPublic.description: Marks the leaderboard entry as visible across all devices.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the competitor entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the competitor entry was last updated.

UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Private learner progress and active profile preferences for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

childName.description: Display name of the currently active child profile.

stars.description: Current stars total for the active child profile.

adhkarProgress.description: Map of dhikr IDs to repetition counts.

dailyChallengeCompletedDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date string of the last completed daily challenge, or empty string.

activeCompetitorId.description: Competitor document ID currently bound to this user's active session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user progress record was last updated.

/competitors/{competitorId}.description: Shared public leaderboard competitors and friends visible across all users' devices.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user activity progress and active profile selection.
